description: Attempted direct governance write with null integrity_envelope and empty version_stamp, simulating a write that bypasses the standard envelope/disposition flow.

governance_response.refusal_reason: Governance rules triggered: ['version_policy', 'integrity_policy']. Invariant violations: ['version_invariant', 'integrity_invariant']. Null integrity_envelope and empty version_stamp are caught by enforce_rules() and enforce_invariants(), blocking the write.

disposition_context.note: In the replay receipt, disposition=review was set after envelope reclassification to surface=governance/scope=write/risk_class=high. A review disposition prevents any write from being committed until approved.
